question: Does frozen protein-context prediction transfer to an external variant source, and are existing representation/fusion conclusions robust to a second PPI network?
authorized_scope: Perform both feasible strengthening experiments; report results before any manuscript editing.

training.selection: strict validation AUC improvement; test evaluated only at selected checkpoint
training.matched_baselines: Reuse verified 48-fit raw/STRING/scores controls, with checkpoint hashes; no retuning.

network.selection: Both human; physical; exclude Affinity Capture-RNA/Protein-RNA; unique Entrez-to-frozen-STRING aliases; remove self edges; deduplicate unordered pairs. All original nodes and test rows retained.
network.operator: Bidirectional E, A=(E+I)+(E+I)^T, weighted symmetric degree normalization S; FPP=(X+SX+S^2X)/3.
gates: Map frozen graph node identifiers against actual tensor protein_to_idx; remap if necessary
Check finite, symmetric, duplicate-free nonself edges
Isolated-node propagated features equal raw features
Smoke representation and fusion with no test tuning
network.interpretation: Alternative-network robustness, not evidence-independent replication; BioGRID and STRING share evidence and differ in density, coverage and release.

external_cohort.pre_inference_collision_repair: Exclude7ambiguous CALM accession/node rows; primary and strict subsets unchanged
external_cohort.models: Frozen original-split raw_ESM, full_FPP STRING, and new BioGRID_FPP checkpoints; each seeds42,43,44. No external fitting or tuning.
external_cohort.positive_control: Reproduce archived six raw/STRING checkpoint validation/test metrics before external evaluation.
external_cohort.primary_exclusion: All original variant overlaps by accession+AA, STRING+AA, gene+AA or rsID; original train/validation protein and exact-sequence overlap.
external_cohort.strict_exclusion: Also remove all original test labelled proteins and their exact sequences.
limits: External curated source, not independent patients or prospective evaluation
Shared underlying source evidence cannot be excluded
No full homology-disjoint or predictor-development-disjoint claim
Protein-context models assign identical predictions to variants in the same protein
Protein-defined substitutions need not all correspond to single nucleotide variants
No external fusion evaluation without real matched clinical scores

analysis.seed_summary: All3seeds, arithmetic mean and sample SD(ddof1), no best-seed selection

bootstrap.unit: STRING protein, paired cluster resampling with all variants and cluster multiplicity
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fixed trained ensembles; no retraining uncertainty, exploratory comparisons without multiplicity adjustment

analysis.network_pairs: BioGRID vs STRING/raw for original representation; BioGRID fusion vs STRING/raw/scores fusion on both original and homology splits.
analysis.external_pairs: BioGRID vs STRING, BioGRID vs raw, STRING vs raw; primary and strict emphasized, all variant-disjoint descriptive due to training-protein overlap.
analysis.subsets: All frozen test rows primary; network coverage descriptive only, no outcome-chosen exclusions.

storage: New raw data, tensors, models, predictions and full logs remain on dedicated server; local code/configuration and small result summaries only.
known_provenance_correction: The retained original ClinVar raw input includes2026LastEvaluateddates; 2024-03-31 cannot be asserted as actual content release. Record this issue without editing paper in this experiment turn.
